annotations.title: Lead paint risk and safe working

description: Judges how likely old paint is to contain lead from the build year, surfaces, paint condition and any test result, checks the planned removal methods (dry sanding, blowlamps and dry scraping are refused; wet abrading, chemical strippers and heat guns below about 450 C are allowed with care), and gives the safe test, removal, clean-up and waste steps from HSE and UK guidance, plus the Control of Lead at Work duties. Returns `urgency` only if paint has already been disturbed unsafely. Example: {"build_year":1935,"surfaces":["windows","doors"],"planned_methods":["dry_sanding"],"children_under_6_or_pregnant":true}.

already_disturbed.description: Old paint has already been sanded, scraped or burnt off without lead precautions.

build_year.description: Year the home (or the painted item) was built.

children_under_6_or_pregnant.description: A child under 6 or a pregnant person lives in or visits the home.

era.description: Use if the exact year is unknown.

original_paint_likely.description: False if the old layers are known to have been stripped back to bare before. Default true.

trade.description: Optional. The decorator's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill quotes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Brush Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Fresh Coat Decorators".

licence_body.description: Trade body or accreditation the business belongs to (pda = Painting and Decorating Association).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

name: lead_paint_risk
